title: The Last Lighthouse
introduction: 1987. A storm has cut power to the island. Offshore, a ship is drifting towards the reefs. Find the keeper's equipment and relight the lighthouse beacon.

quay.name: The deserted quay
quay.description: Mooring ropes creak in the fog. The lighthouse rises to the north; to the east, the keeper's workshop stands against the gale.

workshop.name: The keeper's workshop
workshop.description: The smell of grease clings to the wood. A notice on the workbench reads: 'Backup battery: beacon power supply'. The quay lies to the west.

hall.name: The lighthouse hall
hall.description: A spiral staircase leads up to the lantern room. A copper door guards the way. The surf echoes behind you, to the south.

up.blocked_message: The copper door is locked. Its small lock needs a key.

lantern_room.name: The lantern room
lantern_room.description: Beyond the rain-streaked windows, reefs break the surface. A beacon with a battery socket stands in the centre of the room. The stairs lead down to the hall.

key.name: the copper key
key.description: A small copper key. Its tag reads 'stairs'.

battery.name: the backup battery
battery.description: A charged battery, light enough to carry. Its contacts fit the beacon's battery socket.

door.name: the copper door
door.description: A heavy door guards the staircase. Its lock is made of copper.

beacon.name: the lighthouse beacon
beacon.description: An emergency beacon with a battery socket. Its beam can guide the ship away from the reefs.

rules.message: The key turns in the lock. The door opens, giving you access to the stairs.
You charge the beacon with the backup battery, then take the battery back. The beam comes to life; offshore, the ship steers clear of the reefs.
rules.blocked_message: The beacon is already lit, or the way to it has not been unlocked.
